description: This Java class 'DefaultAcknowledgementsAdapterProvider' implements the 'AcknowledgementAdapterProvider' interface, providing adapters for handling acknowledgements within the Eclipse Ditto protocol framework. It instantiates and supplies specific acknowledgement adapters used in the protocol handling.

classes.name: DefaultAcknowledgementsAdapterProvider
classes.description: A final class implementing the AcknowledgementAdapterProvider interface, responsible for providing acknowledgement-related adapters used in the Ditto protocol framework.

methods.name: DefaultAcknowledgementsAdapterProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes acknowledgement adapters with the provided error registry and header translator.

methods.name: getAdapters
methods.description: Returns a list containing the acknowledgement adapters.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for individual acknowledgements.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementsAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for acknowledgements collection.
